findings.passage: We can show that you can support the Second Amendment and background checks, and red flag laws.
findings.note: Op-ed bylined Steve Roberts (then a state representative) citing a poll; he calls for Jefferson City to act on gun reform, naming background checks and red flag laws alongside Second Amendment support. The piece also cites poll support for a ban on assault-style weapons.

findings.passage: Missourians can support the Second Amendment and stricter gun laws.
findings.note: Same op-ed; general statement that gun rights and stricter gun laws can go together.

findings.passage: The Missouri Legislature’s 2021 passage of the ‘Second Amendment Preservation Act’ means Missouri is the only state in the union to have zero checks on kids who are too young to possess guns. This has tied up our police and made the citizens in our neighborhoods fearful. Fixing this problem makes our communities safer.
findings.note: Senate press release on his pre-filed bill making it unlawful for a minor to possess a concealable firearm or handgun (exceptions for ranges and supervised use). He ties the gap to the Second Amendment Preservation Act and says gun violence must be a legislative priority.
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: It would create a conceal carry permit requirement if you want to conceal or open carry a firearm in public. If you want to keep a firearm in your house, personal safety, I understand,
findings.note: A gun-news site quoting Roberts (relaying a TV station report) on his idea of a carry permit requirement for St. Louis, moving away from permitless carry; the same story quotes him saying permits help police tell lawful from unlawful gun owners. Surrounding commentary is the outlet's, not his.
